_why: #30 option (c), taken over from HemaSuite feature/18-gateway-consolidation. The whole value is that the demotion is PER-PIN: a blanket demotion is provenance-raising with extra steps, which is the masking this was raised to fix. Each mutation has its own `test`.

mutations.name: any-declaration-demotes-every-pin
mutations._mechanism: THE defect this option exists to avoid. Demoting all pins because one was declared is exactly what raising the provenance sha already did -- 26 findings gone, zero pins repaired.

mutations.name: the-declaration-predicate-always-matches
mutations._mechanism: A substring that matches no pin must demote nothing, or the flag is a blanket switch wearing a per-pin costume.
mutations.find: return any(a in span for a in allow_historical)

mutations.name: the-demotion-is-silent
mutations._mechanism: A suppression nobody can see is indistinguishable from a detector that never fired. `allowed` is what makes it auditable.

mutations.name: a-declaration-never-clears-the-verdict
mutations._mechanism: If declaring every drifted pin cannot reach PASS the flag is unusable, and authors go back to raising provenance -- the defect restored by the tool built to fix it.
